title: Advanced Screenwriters Lab (applications open)
summary: Intensive weekly critique group for screenwriters working at a professional level. Members read each other's work ahead of time and schedule a meeting to critique each project. Applications are open and require a writing sample. The listing says it is always free, with no fees to apply or participate.
dateText: Weekly sessions (Sat 11:00 AM PT and Fri 7:00 PM PT)
timeText: Sat 11:00 AM PT · Fri 7:00 PM PT
eligibility: Aimed at produced, repped or emerging screenwriters with multiple completed features or TV pilots; requires a writing sample.
